sj6kxqbw.baseName: My Christmas 3ft Pre-Lit Artificial Christmas Tree with 152 Tips - Green
sj6kxqbw.variantName: My Christmas 3ft Pre-Lit Artificial Christmas Tree with 152 Tips - Green
sj6kxqbw.sourceDescription: Bring festive charm to your home with this 3ft artificial Christmas tree, featuring 152 dense, dual-tone PE branch tips for a realistic pine appearance. The pre-lit design includes warm white and multicolour LED lights, creating a cosy seasonal atmosphere without the need for additional lighting. With 12 lighting modes and a remote control, you can easily customise the display to suit your festive décor, with options including COMB, Steady ON, Colour Cycle, Slo-Glo, Breathing, Flash and In Wave. The sturdy 15cm cement base, wrapped in natural burlap, provides stability while adding a rustic decorative touch. Its compact design makes it ideal for desks, tables, shelves, offices and smaller living spaces. Specifications: 3ft artificial Christmas tree with 152 PE branch tips, dual-colour warm white and multicolour LED lighting, 12 lighting modes, remote control and a weighted cement base wrapped in natural burlap. Read the operating instructions before use. Vivo Technologies Limited, Unit 11, Rainsford Road, London, NW10 7RG

yh9qs76a.baseName: Christmas Tree World 6ft Ultra Devonshire Fir - Warm White/Multi-Colour Lights
yh9qs76a.variantName: Christmas Tree World 6ft Ultra Devonshire Fir - Warm White/Multi-Colour Lights
yh9qs76a.sourceDescription: Our most popular pre-lit Christmas tree, the 6ft Ultra Devonshire Fir tree combines stunning realism with a wonderful lighting display. There's no need to untangle any Christmas lights yourself with this one. Just click the button on the controller box to soften your tree with a warm white or go kaleidoscopic with the multicoloured option - the lighting choice is all yours! There are 8 different lighting functions, including the classic 'always on' as well as the unique flashing function that effortlessly mixes both colours together. Picture shows 7ft tree in our range. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included. Product Features • Size: 6ft • Number of branch tips: 1063 PE/PVC branch tips • Pre-lit: Professionally hand strung with 450 LED lights • Tree width: 120cm diameter • LED colour-changing technology: Both warm white & multicolour modes • Functions: Multifunctional with 8 settings including static • Foliage colour: Dark natural green • Realistic look: A mix of ultra-realistic plastic moulded tips, with traditional PVC tips to fill out any gaps • Easy assembly: Attached hinged branches • Sturdy base: Folding metal stand with plastic tips to prevent scratching • Fire-resistant: Fire retardancy certified • Indoor use only: The tree's construction will rust in rain • Height measured from the floor • Eligible for European shipping • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom

r3tx8v91.baseName: Walplus 300 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree 120 cm Wide - Black - 210 cm
r3tx8v91.variantName: Walplus 300 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree 120 cm Wide - Black - 210 cm
r3tx8v91.sourceDescription: This cone-shaped PVC Artificial Christmas Tree brings modern elegance to your seasonal decor with its sleek and simple design. It enhances any living space or garden, creating a festive presence with minimal ornamentation and maximum impact. Its visually appealing structure can serve as a centerpiece for gatherings, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere while maintaining a stylish appearance that aligns with contemporary aesthetics. Quality PVC Build The tree is constructed from high-quality PVC, known for its durability and weather resistance, making it suitable for both indoor and outdoor use. The material ensures longevity while mimicking the lush, evergreen foliage of a real tree, lending a natural look to your decor. Versatile LED Lighting Equipped with flexible LED strip lights, this tree offers warm white illumination that can be adapted to various settings. The USB connection allows for convenient powering options, enabling usage in multiple environments without the need for traditional power adapters. Modern Design With clean lines and a minimalist form, it fits seamlessly into modern decor styles. The understated elegance enhances any space, allowing you to decorate creatively with ornaments or lights for a personalized touch. Easy Installation Requires simple assembly with a screwdriver, accommodating those with minimal DIY experience. The straightforward setup ensures that your holiday preparation is stress-free so you can focus on the festive activities. Indoor &Outdoor Use Suitable for living rooms, gardens, and terraces, this tree adds charm both inside and outside. Its weather-resistant build makes it a flexible addition to your holiday decorations, approachable for various settings and scenarios. Product Specifications Colour: Black Material: PVC Tree height: 210 cm Bottom diameter: 120 cm Stand size: 45 x 45 cm Hinged construction for set up lightweight and break-resistant Number of PVC tips: 910 Lights type: LED strip lights Lights color: Warm white Number of LEDs: 300 Distance between LEDs: 1000 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Voltage: 5 V Wattage: 5 W Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string light 1 x Peak 40 x 3 cm ball 40 x 4 cm ball 40 x 6 cm ball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

jewg4m4q.baseName: COSTWAY 5FT Christmas Tree w/ LED lights Artificial Xmas Tree - Green
jewg4m4q.variantName: COSTWAY 5FT Christmas Tree w/ LED lights Artificial Xmas Tree - Green
jewg4m4q.sourceDescription: The 140/200 lights controlled via the remote control with 9 lighting modes and the snowy design create the festive atmosphere. You can also hang Christmas decorations on the numerous branches as you wish. The Christmas tree with dense branches looks like the real thing from a distance, but it doesn't needle. The metal stand is sturdy and durable and the PVC branches are non-toxic and fireproof, guaranteeing safety. The automatic hinge construction makes it very easy to assemble and store. Therefore, you can constantly reuse the Christmas tree. 9 Light Modes and Remote Control: This Christmas tree with 140/200 lights has 9 lighting modes that you can control through the remote control. Among them is not only the warm white light, but also the glitter light suitable for parties. Realistic Snowy Branches: The white flocking on the surface makes the Christmas tree look like it is covered in snow. The 161/269 PVC branches and 118/154 pine branches make the tree very realistic. Automatic Opening and Easy Maintenance: The Christmas tree has a simple structure and is easy to assemble. Once assembled, the automatic hinge makes it easy to unfold the branches, which means you don't have to open it manually. As it does not needle, you do not need to sweep the floor. Sturdy Base and Premium Material: The branches are made of high quality PVC, so they are safe, non-toxic, odourless and fireproof. The metal stand provides strong support for the tree and keeps it stable. Easy Storage and Versatile Use: Since the branches and stand are foldable, you can reuse the Christmas tree next year when not in use. It can be used at home, office, public places, etc. to create a festive atmosphere. Specifications: Colour: Green Material: PVC, Iron Dimensions: 65 x 155 cm/76 x 185 cm(Ø x H) Number of lights: 140/200 Number of PVC branches: 161/269 Number of pine needles: 118/154 Rated voltage: 220-240V Gross weight: 5/7 kg Net weight: 4/6 kg Box Qty:1(May vary by batch) Is Assembly Required: Yes Package Includes: 1 x Christmas Tree 1 x Remote Control 1 x Instruction Manual Retain instructions for future reference.always place the product on a flat, steady and stable surface.keep all small parts and packaging materials for this product away from babies and children as they potentially pose a serious choking hazard. FDS CORPORATION LIMITED Unit 4, Blackacre Road, Great Blakenham, Ipswich, United Kingdom, IP6 0FL

p01kgsjt.sourceDescription: Add a welcoming feature to your front door this Christmas with our artificial spruce wreath. Designed with lush, bushy foliage and dual-coloured needles. • Choose from a 45cm wreath with 140 tips or a 60cm wreath with 200 tips to create a perfect indoor or outdoor display • Tips are made from PVC and are different shades, widths, and thicknesses to give the wreath a natural, bushy finish • Plain design makes it great for adding lights and decorations, plus you can leave it undecorated for a traditional look • Pre-attached frame is coloured dark green to blend in with the foliage and allows you to easily hang it on a door or wall • Comes in a sturdy box for protection during transit, complete with a guide to help you fluff it up and prepare it for display Specifications: • Brand: Christow • Diameter: 60cm • Material: PE • Weight: 0.75kg For decorative use only. Not a toy. Keep away from heat and naked flames. Ensure the product is securely positioned before use. Read and follow all instructions and safety warnings before use. Wilton Bradley Ltd, 8 Wentworth Road, Heathfield Industrial Estate, Newton Abbot, Devon, TQ12 6TL
